items.title: Tripo P2 Image to 3D
items.shortDescription: Tripo P2 generates 3D models from a single image, with optional PBR textures, adjustable face counts, and triangle or quad mesh topology.
items.pricingInfoOverride: Billing is calculated per generated 3D model. Each request costs **$1.00** without textures, **$1.10** with fast or standard textures, **$1.20** with detailed textures, or **$1.30** with extreme textures. PBR enables textures and uses the selected texture rate. Quad topology adds no extra charge. For example, **10 models** with standard textures cost **$11.00**. To generate without textures, set both texture and pbr to false.

items.title: Meshy T2.5 Image to 3D
items.shortDescription: Meshy T2.5 is Meshy's latest Smart Topology model. It converts a single image into a clean, triangle-only 3D mesh with natively separated parts, with a target polycount of up to 30,000 triangles (default 15,000). Compared with Meshy T2, it produces sharper detail and keeps shape and proportions closer to the input image, at the cost of longer generation times; optional textures, PBR maps and humanoid rigging are supported.
items.pricingInfoOverride: Billing is calculated per generation. An untextured mesh costs **$0.20**, and a textured mesh costs **$0.60**; PBR maps and the choice of texture model are included at no extra charge. Optional auto-rigging adds **$0.20**, and animation adds **$0.12** per call. A textured model with auto-rigging and animation costs **$0.92**. Failed requests are not billed. For **$10** you can generate **50** untextured meshes or **16** textured meshes.

items.title: MoGe-3
items.shortDescription: Estimates metric 3D geometry from a single image, returning a point map, depth, surface normals, a validity mask and the camera field of view. A sparse 3D refiner sharpens the predicted depth, and the result can be exported as a textured GLB mesh and a colored PLY point cloud.
items.pricingInfoOverride: Billing is calculated per megapixel of the input image, rounded up to the next whole megapixel, with a minimum of **1** megapixel per request. Each megapixel costs **$0.015**. A **1600×1067** image (1.7 MP) costs **$0.03**, a **1920×1080** image (2.1 MP) costs **$0.045**, and the largest supported input, **2048×2048** (4.2 MP), costs **$0.075**. Depth, normal and mask maps, camera intrinsics and the optional GLB mesh and PLY point cloud are included. For **$1** you can process about **33** images at **1600×1067**.
items.billingMessage: 1 megapixel = 1,000,000 pixels, so a 1024×1024 image counts as 2 megapixels.
